method: Five Oklab clusters per quadrant; alpha<32 ignored; alpha-weighted cluster area to exponent 0.7 with moderate chroma weighting; clusters under 5% excluded; use the original selector when no eligible cluster has Oklab chroma >=0.06; preserve the existing dark penalty. The representative is an RGB pixel from the at-most-128px analysis thumbnail, closest to the chosen perceptual center. No pixel chroma boost, color invention, RGB averaging, or source-image persistence.
